nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address that must call acceptOwnership() to complete a two-step ownership transfer.
Public token symbol string, initialised to 'JADE' in the constructor.
Public token name string, initialised to 'Jade Token' in the constructor.
Public decimals value (18) describing token divisibility.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor to 125000000000000000000000000.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Public pure helper performing c = a + b with an overflow check (require c >= a).
Public pure helper performing c = a - b with an underflow check (require b <= a).
Public pure helper performing c = a * b with an overflow check (require a == 0 || c / a == b).
Public pure helper performing c = a / b with a divide-by-zero guard (require b > 0).
Constructor of Owned that sets owner = msg.sender, establishing initial privileged control.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address in newOwner.
Function that lets the staged newOwner become owner after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints the whole supply to a hard-coded MEW address and emits Transfer.
Constant getter returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Constant getter returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath arithmetic and emitting Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to', mutating balances and allowed via SafeMath.
Constant getter returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract, an untrusted external callback.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain Ether transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by the contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and balance mutation.
Raw unsigned addition a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by a post-hoc require.
Raw unsigned subtraction a - b inside safeSub, guarded only by a pre-check require.
Raw unsigned multiplication a * b inside safeMul, guarded by an equality require.
Balance decrement balances[msg.sender] - tokens executed through safeSub during transfer.
Balance and allowance decrements performed through safeSub during transferFrom.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-supplied contract address, reentrancy-capable.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied token address, reentrancy-capable.
